card.name: The word than after less or younger
card.fires_on: The word "than" right after "less", "younger" or "greater" when an age or amount limit follows. Most often in contraindications for children under a stated age.

modes.label: Age limits
modes.description: "than" after "less" or "younger" before a number of years or months in pediatric restrictions.
modes.example: Pediatric patients less<< than>> two months of age ( 4 )

card.plain: It marks the word "than" in phrases like "children younger than 12 years", where an age cutoff is about to be given.
